blocks.content:
Act: 2013
Statutory Pension Regulator
Regulates NPS
Based on OASIS Report
HQ: New Delhi
Promotes Retirement Security

items: The pension regulator was constituted as a statutory body under the Act of 2013.
Always remember that the National Pension System (NPS) regulation is based on the OASIS Report.
Headquarters of the Statutory Pension Regulator is situated in New Delhi.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Operates as a statutory pension regulator established under the 2013 Act.
Responsible for regulating and developing the National Pension System (NPS).
Conceptualized and established based on the recommendations of the OASIS Report.
Headquartered in New Delhi, focusing on promoting retirement security across the nation.
